items.source: Uses of UserDestinationResult in org.springframework.messaging.simp.user
Support for handling messages to "user" destinations (i.e.

Resolve the given message with a user destination to one or more messages
with actual destinations, one for each active user session.
items.translation: 将带有用户目标的给定消息解析为一条或多条带有实际目标的消息，每个活动用户会话对应一条。
